mainEntity.name: Can Feichi substations comply with Russian GOST and Siberian Arctic conditions?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Feichi manufactures 2КТПН and БМЗ modular substations certified to ГОСТ 14695-80 and ГОСТ 15150-69 УХЛ1 climate standards (-60°C to +40°C). Our arctic-grade substations feature 100mm PU insulation cladding, automatic PTC microclimate heating, and heavy-duty Cor-Ten steel chassis (09Г2С).

mainEntity.name: Does Feichi hold official licenses from global giants like Schneider Electric and ABB?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Feichi holds official authorized panel builder licenses for Schneider Electric Blokset LV switchgear (up to 6300A, Form 4b segregation) and ABB UniSafe MV air-insulated switchgear & MDmax intelligent digital switchboards.

mainEntity.name: What is the typical manufacturing lead time for customized compact substations and E-Houses?

acceptedAnswer.text: Standard 10kV-35kV packaged compact substations are manufactured within 20-30 working days. Large customized containerized E-Houses (БМЗ) and utility-scale PV/BESS MV Skids take 35-45 working days, including full factory acceptance testing (FAT) and vacuum seaworthy packaging.

mainEntity.name: Can Feichi supply official type-test reports from accredited high-voltage laboratories?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. All export equipment carries official stamped Type-Test Certificates from National High-Voltage Quality Inspection Centers (NHVS) verifying temperature rise, dielectric withstand (BIL up to 200kV), short-circuit withstand (up to 40kA/3s), and internal arc containment (IAC AFLR 31.5kA/1s).
